basis: The dashboard shows the District Heating Demand Index falling from 24.0°C in 2005 to 10.0°C in 2015, a full-period decrease of 14.0 units. This represents a reduction of approximately 58% over the review period. Although no explicit numeric threshold is printed on the chart, a change of this magnitude (a drop of more than half the initial value) is not consistent with 'ordinary variation' and meets the ordinary meaning of a substantial change requiring follow-up.
option_label: Route the 2005 to 2015 district heat demand change to substantial-change follow-up
